meta.title: Super Linkomanija – browser extension for Linkomanija.net (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)
meta.description: Free extension for Linkomanija.net: release previews, a grid view with posters, related releases, notifications about awaited releases, auto login, comment formatting and history. For Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
meta.ogImageAlt: Super Linkomanija, the browser extension for Linkomanija.net

hero.tagline: Super Linkomanija is a free browser extension for Linkomanija.net. Preview releases without opening them, browse the list as a grid of posters, get notified when a release you're waiting for appears and stay logged in on all your devices. Switch each feature on or off, keep only what you use.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Everything works on Linkomanija's own pages, in both its light and dark themes. Every feature can be switched on or off in the extension's popup, and changes apply to open tabs straight away.

items.title: Release preview
items.text: Hover the eye icon in the release list to see a release's description, poster and details in a popup, without opening its page.

items.title: List and grid view
items.text: Switch the release list between the classic table and a grid of cards with posters, size, seeders and leechers. Your choice is remembered.

items.title: Related releases
items.text: Release pages list related releases, so other versions are one click away, without searching.

items.title: Comment formatting
items.text: A rich-text editor for comments: bold, italic, colours, links, images, quotes and Linkomanija's own smileys, written as BBCode for you.

items.title: Back to top
items.text: A button on every page that takes you back to the top in one click.

items.title: Homepage redirect
items.text: Opening Linkomanija's homepage takes you straight to the release list. Off by default.

items.title: Release notifier
items.text: Waiting for a new release? Add a search term, plus keywords to skip (like beta) or prefer (like LTS). The extension checks Linkomanija every 6 hours and tells you when it appears, with a number on the toolbar icon and a notice on the site. Off by default.

items.title: Auto login
items.text: Log in once and you're logged in on every browser synced with your browser account. Logging out in one logs out the others. Switch it off if you don't want that.

items.title: Theme follows system
items.text: Linkomanija switches between its light and dark themes with your system, category icons included, without changing your profile. Off by default.

items.title: History
items.text: The popup lists your last viewed, downloaded and commented releases, with all-time totals.

install.title: Install
install.intro: Install from your browser's store: one click, and it updates automatically.

chrome.title: Chrome
chrome.text: From the Chrome Web Store. Opera, Vivaldi and Brave install it from there too.

firefox.title: Firefox
firefox.text: From Firefox Add-ons, Firefox 142 or newer.

after: Open Linkomanija.net and log in as usual. The features appear on the site's pages.
Click the extension's icon in the toolbar to switch features on or off, see your history and change the popup's language.
Pin the icon to the toolbar to keep it at hand: the puzzle piece icon, then the pin next to Super Linkomanija.
install.manual: Every version is also on GitHub releases. To load it in Chrome or Edge, unzip the Chrome package, open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions, switch on Developer mode and choose Load unpacked. It won't update on its own.

items.a: Yes. It's free and open source under the MIT license, with no ads and no paid features.
No. Your settings and history stay in your browser, and there are no analytics or tracking. Nothing is ever sent to the developer. See the privacy policy.

items.q: Is it an official Linkomanija extension?
items.a: No. It's an independent project and isn't affiliated with Linkomanija.net.

items.q: Does it need my Linkomanija password?
items.a: No. You log in to Linkomanija.net as usual, and the extension never sees your password. Auto login only keeps the website's "remember me" login cookie, synced through your own browser account, and deletes it when you log out or switch the feature off.
Chrome, Microsoft Edge and Firefox, plus Opera, Vivaldi and Brave through the Chrome Web Store.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Super Linkomanija collects no personal data: settings and history stay in your browser, with no analytics or tracking.

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: Super Linkomanija doesn't collect, sell or share any personal data. It has no analytics, no tracking and no servers of its own.

sections.title: What it stores
sections.body:
The extension saves the following in your browser's extension storage:

  • which features are switched on or off, and the chosen release list view
  • the popup's language
  • your history: the last 25 viewed, downloaded and commented releases per group, each with its ID, title and category image address
  • for the release notifier: your search terms and keywords, the releases you rejected, and the found releases with the time of the last check
  • for auto login: Linkomanija's "remember me" login cookie and the time you last logged out

If you use your browser's sync, the browser can sync this data between your own devices through your browser account. Found releases are kept on each device only. Nothing is ever sent to the developer.

The login cookie gives access to your Linkomanija account, like a password. It stays saved until you log out through the website or switch auto login off. Logging out doesn't make an already copied cookie invalid, only changing your Linkomanija password does.

sections.title: Network requests
sections.body:
The extension only talks to Linkomanija.net. On your behalf and with your existing login it loads release pages for previews and related releases, and adds or removes bookmarks when you click them. When the release notifier is on, it also searches Linkomanija for your watched releases when the browser starts, every 6 hours and when you ask. Smileys in the comment editor load from Linkomanija's own image server. No other websites are contacted.

When you uninstall the extension, the browser opens this website. No data is sent with it.

sections.title: Permissions
sections.body:
• Access to linkomanija.net: to add the features to the site's pages and to search for watched releases
  • Storage: to save your settings, history, watched releases and login
  • Tabs: to show the toolbar icon as active on Linkomanija.net, and to apply setting changes to open Linkomanija tabs straight away
  • Alarms: to check watched releases every 6 hours
  • Notifications (optional): only asked for when you switch on system notifications for the release notifier

sections.title: Removing your data
sections.body: Switching auto login off deletes the saved login cookie. Uninstalling the extension deletes everything it stored.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about privacy can be asked on GitHub.
